title: 3 AI tricks that feel like magic

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The number 3 is the foundation of AI magic—transform, adapt, and evolve. It's not just a number, it's a protocol.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: AI isn't just about numbers—it's about neural networks, self-learning, and real-world impact that 3 can't replicate.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: 3 is the core of SSL/TLS encryption, the basis of triple DES, and a proven security protocol that AI can't match.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: AI can process billions of data points, recognize patterns, and predict outcomes in ways no fixed number ever could.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: 3 is magic because it's reliable. AI is magic because it's unpredictable. Choose the one you can trust.
